column1: # Rule 36 (secret-material locality): the production sites outside the
# crypto-owning crates that clamp or reduce secret bytes. Read by
# scripts/ci/check_secret_byte_locality.py, which fails on a site with no
# row and on a row with no site. Columns, tab-separated: path, kind
# (clamp | reduce), the call's text as the gate normalizes it, reason.
# A row is keyed by text, not line, so a reflow does not move it. The
# crypto crates themselves need no rows (the gate's CRYPTO_CRATES).
